title: VTC Join Requests — Query — payload
description: An administrator asks the community to open a credential exchange with a prospective member: to issue a presentation challenge, build the credential-exchange/query for a registered Accepts criterion, and deliver it. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

holderDid.description: The holder the query is for — the prospective member whose agent will answer it.

criterionId.description: The registered Accepts criterion (vtc/schemas/accepts/register) whose DCQL query to send.

CredentialQuery.title: CredentialQuery
CredentialQuery.description: The payload of the credential-exchange/query/0.1 document the community built for the holder — the DCQL query, the freshness nonce it bound to its own DID and the returned thread, and the purpose shown to the holder. A community MUST emit a value that validates against the credential-exchange/query/0.1 payload schema; its members are that specification's, and are not restated here. snake_case member names are DCQL's own.

Response.title: VTC Join Requests — Query — response payload

threadId.description: The exchange's thread: the `id` of the credential-exchange/query document, and the `threadId` the holder's credential-exchange/present must carry. The presentation challenge is keyed by it.

delivered.description: Whether the community accepted the query for delivery — queued to its outbox, which sends and retries it. Not a confirmation of receipt. False when it has no route to the holder or could not queue it; the caller can then relay `query` itself.
